entities.name: American Civil War Blockade Running
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Nassau experienced an economic boom as a hub for Confederate blockade runners during the American Civil War. Cotton was shipped out and war supplies smuggled back to the South, bringing enormous profits to Bahamian merchants.
